object.content: After all of the horror stories I've heard about #Paypal  customer service, I actually had a good experience. When you look up their phone number on your account, they give you a code that you enter so the person knows your account details from the start. It was a 15 minute phone call and about 10 minutes was waiting to talk to a person. The problem I had was that someone sent a payment to an old email address. I was told to enter that email address in the website and a minute later they confirmed the payment and put it in my account. It was pretty quick and painless.
